items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: That was old man Henry Allen... I done played at him many times.

ctx.x: Yeah. I never knew it was very good. We talked to his brother Ben Kelly is still there. Yeah. Maybe he told us I forgot. He told us where he was born.
Oh I beg your pardon. He wasn't quite full as son Henry was from Magnolia. Yeah. But he was between Magnolia and this other big farm he had got down there. I just remember.
Jim says he came from Deer Range I think.
